name: aad-h1-units
_rate: the recorded basis (durability_plan.json :: blocked.options; Stage-0's volumes trued up at it)
_reserved: 30 GB x $0.07 x 2 months, booked inside the H1 P1g/P2 $50 envelope from creation (unit_governance.spent) until this record states actual_usd
consumer: H1 P1g and P2: the durable root <mount>/h1 -- the four formal checkpoints, a unit's save points while it trains, the evaluation progress and evidence
retire_by: 2026-12-23 at the latest (the end of the reservation), or earlier once its checkpoints have no consumer (AGENTS.md 2.5); deleting it, or keeping it past the reservation, is booked here first

retirement.rule: AGENTS.md 2.5 standing retirement of historical checkpoint weights (maintainer 2026-10-24: review H1's storage by the lifecycle rule, leave no unbounded billing)

conditions.terminal: H1 closed and annulled for promotion (plans/h1_annulment.json); every unit is one complete endpoint
conditions.evidence_durable: each unit's evidence tarball on the relay (stage2_h1/units/evidence/<unit>.evidence.tgz, LFS sha256 equal to the closeouts' runs/h1p2*/closeout/outcome.json :: evidence) and extracted on the dev box (artifacts/stages/stage-2/reasoning_data/units/evidence/); reports, descriptors and rows in git (units/<unit>/)
conditions.identities_preserved: every checkpoint's artifact and weights digest in units/<unit>/checkpoint.descriptor.json
conditions.no_consumer: plans/h1_annulment.json :: checkpoint_consumers (2026-10-24): no launcher, setup, plan or driver reads them; H1-PA does not
conditions.not_an_anchor: no incumbent, release or retained anchor

retirement.members_basis: DERIVED from the unit drivers' writes and the closeouts, not listed on a pod (no budget funds one): the four persisted checkpoints; the trainers' save points were released after each persistence (units/<unit>/attempts.jsonl); each unit's eval_progress holds the generations its evidence tarball already carries; P1g's validation bytes were released by p1g_driver
retirement.never_deleted: logs and evidence: everything above stays where it is
